title: Enterprise Support: Provider consumption evidence
content:
Enterprise Support — Provider consumption evidence.

## Policy clauses

The authoritative export confirms the resource interval and the measured quantity.

Meters originate in the provider resource export.

Primary meter quantities use usage unit; a meter is positive and a consumption reversal is the negative of the exact erroneous source quantity, capped by the source quantity not already reversed.

Keep original interval, region, configuration and source reference.

billing of actual measured overage overage permits measured quantities above included quantity; no service entitlement is invented by a meter write.

Round measured quantities to meter quantity decimal precision using rounding convention, apply minimum quantity and round positive billable primary quantities upward to a whole meter quantum.

Stopped or suspended service accrues no primary running usage, but real retained storage and other supplemental services remain billable through supplemental consumption entry.

A rejected or cancelled source is not a billable meter.

Repeated exports with the same resource, meter, interval and correction reference are read-only confirmations.

## Authoritative evidence

The authoritative export confirms the resource interval and the measured quantity. The authoritative system record must establish the condition before the action. Its evidence comprises support event reference, external reference, inclusive service start, exclusive service end, quantity. Correlate the action to the same support event reference.
